scripts.ios:build: bun run ios:project && bun run ios:codegen && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/{{APP_NAME}}.xcodeproj -scheme {{APP_NAME}} -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build/derived SWIFT_ENABLE_EXPLICIT_MODULES=NO build
scripts.ios:test: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcodebuild -project ios/{{APP_NAME}}.xcodeproj -scheme {{APP_NAME}} -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${IOS_SIMULATOR:-iPhone 17}" -derivedDataPath build/derived SWIFT_ENABLE_EXPLICIT_MODULES=NO test
